connector.name: Buildpulse MCP
connector.registryDescription: BuildPulse CI test analytics for AI agents - flaky tests, coverage, and CI run history.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.buildpulse.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the buildpulsellc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <40-char BuildPulse API token>. Or use OAuth — see /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server for the discovery doc.

env.name: BUILDPULSE_TOKEN
env.description: 40-character BuildPulse API token. Get one at app.buildpulse.io → Organization Settings → API Tokens.

env.name: PLATFORM_API_URL
env.description: Override the platform API base URL. Default: https://platform.buildpulse.io
